product.olivetti-pcs42.summary: The consumer PCS offered in two sizes with a Microstar motherboard and VESA Local Bus.
product.olivetti-pcs42.history: A European Commission notice cites an August 1994 report that included the PCS 42 in Olivetti’s consumer multimedia range. The service guide identifies the motherboard as Microstar.
product.olivetti-pcs42.architecture: The case changes the available expansion. The Tin Box offers three shared AT/VESA slots and the Slim Tin Box offers one.
product.olivetti-pcs42.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-pcs42.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-pcs42.service-guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 8
product.olivetti-pcs42.eu-notice: European Commission, Official Journal C 306, 15 October 1996, notice 96/C 306/08, note 10
